notes: Tennessee has no personal income tax on wages or self-employment income (the Hall tax on investment income was fully repealed for tax years beginning in 2021).

Important for LLC owners: unlike a sole proprietorship, a Tennessee LLC owned by an individual is NOT disregarded for franchise and excise tax. It must file Form FAE170 every year and pay franchise tax of 0.25% of net worth ($100 minimum). It also owes the 6.5% excise tax on net earnings, but a single-member LLC owned by an individual may deduct the earnings subject to federal self-employment tax (Schedule J2), so for a typical service freelancer the excise tax is usually $0 or small. The calculator does not include the franchise tax; sole proprietors without an LLC are exempt.

State business tax on gross receipts applies only when gross sales in a county (and separately in a city) reach $100,000 (most services: Classification 3, 0.1875%; minimum $22 per location, $44 inside a city); between $3,000 and $100,000 only a $15 minimal activity license per county/city is required. Not modeled.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $300 Articles of Organization for a single-member LLC ($50 per member, $300 minimum, $3,000 maximum; Tennessee Secretary of State form SS-4270).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $300 annual report for an LLC with up to 6 members (plus $50 per member over 6, $3,000 maximum), due every year by the first day of the fourth month after fiscal year end (April 1 for calendar-year entities).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: LLCs (including single-member LLCs owned by an individual) must file a franchise and excise tax return (FAE170) each year: franchise tax of 0.25% of net worth with a $100 annual minimum, plus 6.5% excise tax on net earnings after deducting earnings subject to federal self-employment tax (so a service freelancer's LLC usually owes little or no excise tax and pays about the $100 minimum). Sole proprietors and general partnerships are not subject.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: Tennessee business tax applies once gross sales in a county or city reach $100,000: most services are Classification 3 at 0.1875% of gross receipts, $22 minimum per location ($44 in a city). Between $3,000 and $100,000 only a $15 minimal activity license per county (and city) is required; $3,000 or less needs no license.
